goal: Build visual mockups for Calendar, Photos, Phone, and Journal.
summary: Phase 6 Core Apps Batch 2 completed. Calendar, Photos, Phone, and Journal are implemented as visual/interactive mockups: Calendar with month grid, event dots, and calendar sources; Photos with grid of gradient placeholder thumbnails and single-photo detail view; Phone with Recents, Contacts, and Voicemail tabs; Journal with entry list sidebar and editable entry editor. Removed unused AppPlaceholder. Added unit tests for each app (calendar, photos, phone, journal). Verification: 74 unit tests pass, 12 e2e tests pass, production build succeeds.
